description: ZOTHOS Master Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server Registry. Servers with enabled true are started by coding agents. The others are installed in the catalog and stay off until zoth-mcp enable <name>. Path tokens ${ZOTH_HOME} and ${ZOTH_SRC_ROOT} are expanded by zoth-mcp sync to the active home and checkout root.
